ledger.name: M8_volume_and_parent_potential_data
ledger.note: Vacuum/cosmological and parent-potential coefficients are not related to the M5/M4 coefficients by the current stratified action.

ledger.name: M8_two_derivative_geometry_eta
ledger.note: The parent Einstein/carrier/eta sector remains independently normalized under the current action ownership.

ledger.name: M5_cap_Einstein_scalar_data
ledger.note: The cap Wilson data remain independent, but the GHY coefficient is fixed relative to the owned cap Einstein coefficient and is not an extra parameter.

ledger.name: M4_intrinsic_local_action
ledger.note: Gauge, Yukawa/Dirac, Higgs/scalar and current normalizations are intrinsic M4 data in the authoritative stratified action unless a new microscopic relation is adopted.

ledger.name: relative_nonlocal_spectral
ledger.note: The Gaussian determinant coefficient is fixed by field statistics; the physical relative value is still unevaluated until the complete gauge-fixed parent/child operators and renormalization prescription exist.

ledger.name: Berger_connection_curvature_endomorphism
ledger.note: The extra scalar curvature endomorphism branch remains locked to xi=0.

ledger.name: three_transverse_shape_channels
ledger.note: The channel basis is action-owned; amplitudes/phases are to be selected by the periodic global BVP/Floquet orbit, not inserted as Wilson coefficients.

ledger.name: cosmological_parent_anchor
ledger.note: R_H is a solution variable on the zero-input coupled cosmology branch, or a frozen external anchor on the explicitly finite-input effective branch; it is not a local action coefficient.

ledger.name: common_positive_classical_action_scale
ledger.note: A common positive multiplier leaves the classical Euler-Lagrange zero set unchanged. Relative quantum/local weights must still be kept consistent.
